D/ [T CAES IMP] AVG F TR P COS VI CENSOR

A Roman copper alloy coin: as of Titus AD77-78. Mint of Lugdunum. RIC no. 868. Reverse: Spes. Obverse: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: [T CAES IMP] AVG F TR P COS VI CENSOR. Reverse: Spes, draped, advancing left holding up flower in right hand, and raising skirt with left. Reverse inscription: SC. Die axis measurement: 6.00. Dimensions: diameter: 26.35mm; weight: 6.15g
